description: Official U.S. government data (Census ACS and PUMS, BLS, BEA, IRS SOI, OPM, FRED, CDC, Treasury, USDA and 60 more agencies): use it for any question that needs official statistics or an estimate built on them. With a question: the source packs ranked for it (a hint: split the question into measures and give each its source). Without one: every source with its agency, key need and example questions.
name: find_sources
title: Find sources
